title: Insurers claim AI is already increasing healthcare costs
slides: Insurers say AI is driving up healthcare costs. Why?
They cite increased utilization from AI-assisted diagnoses.
But some argue AI actually reduces unnecessary procedures.
Check your next medical bill for AI-related charges.
Question insurer claims; demand transparent AI cost data.
thread_text:
1. AI Diagnoses, Higher Bills?

Insurers claim AI-assisted diagnoses are driving up healthcare costs by increasing utilization. Is your next bill about to jump?

2. More Scans, More Money?

AI tools flag suspicious findings earlier, leading to more tests and procedures. Insurers say that's the real cost driver.

3. But AI Cuts Waste Too

Some studies show AI reduces unnecessary procedures by catching false positives. So why are insurers only talking about higher costs?

4. Check Your Bill for AI

Next time you get a medical bill, look for new AI-related charges. They're already appearing in some itemized statements.

5. Demand Transparent Data

Ask your insurer for AI cost breakdowns. If they can't show the numbers, question the claim. Do it today.
